overview.text: 在 commonly means being present or located somewhere, including “be at” or “be in.” One account proposes 才 was reused to write 在, but 才’s old object and name are unsettled, so the sound basis is unverified.

components.text: In the received-form analysis, 土 contributes meaning; its relation to 士 in early forms is disputed.
才 supplies the sound in the received-form analysis; early accounts differ over its role and placement.
One disputed account places 士 in the early graph as a proposed second sound element.
